summary.text: Brian Poindexter, a Democrat, won the election for Ohio's 7th District on November 3, 2026, defeating Republican Rep. Max Miller, according to unofficial results, and will take office on January 3, 2027. A union ironworker and apprenticeship instructor for Ironworkers Local 17, he was elected to the Brook Park City Council in 2017 and won a crowded Democratic primary on May 5, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Poindexter graduated from John Marshall High School and earned an associate degree from Cuyahoga Community College.
He describes his father as a union machinist and says he started working in a machine shop at 15.

He has worked as a union ironworker and, by his own account, spent about 20 years as an ironworker and apprenticeship instructor. As of 2026 he is an apprenticeship instructor for Ironworkers Local 17, according to the Ohio Capital Journal.
Poindexter was elected to the Brook Park City Council in 2017 and has served as an at-large member.
He won the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary with 37.0% of the vote, ahead of Ed FitzGerald (21.6%) and other candidates, and faced Republican Rep. Max Miller in the November general election.
He described his campaign as centered on workers' wages, health care costs and ending corporate money in politics.
He won the November 3, 2026 general election with 54.9% of the vote to Max Miller's 45.1%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
